setting: Interior airplane cabin, row 41, night, hour 14 of a Los Angeles to Sydney flight. Dim cold blue night lighting, gray scratchy blankets, sleeping passengers, a thin orange line of dawn in the window.

references.notes: Match Priya's hair, hoodie and eye mask to the character sheet.

style: Gritty 1990s 35mm film look, heavy film grain, anamorphic bokeh, soft halation around lights, handheld feel, soft diffused light, raw and nostalgic. 9:16 vertical.

characters.name: Priya
characters.description: Early 30s South Asian woman, 5'5", medium build, warm brown skin, dark brown eyes, shoulder-length black hair flattened on one side, gray zip hoodie, white tee, black leggings, white sneakers, black backpack, small gold stud earrings, black eye mask pushed up on her forehead on the plane

voice.tone: warm, wry, increasingly panicked, then delighted

action: Priya sits upright and wide awake. At 0.5 seconds she cups her hand over her mouth and breathes out, sniffs her palm, and her face falls apart. She holds the horrified stare through the final second.

voiceover.speaker: Priya
voiceover.line: Eight months. That's how long he's waited for this kiss.
voiceover.timing: Begins no earlier than 0.5 seconds in. Ends no later than 7 seconds (one full second before shot end).

camera.movement: Single slow push-in toward her eyes
camera.end: Extreme close-up on her wide eyes and hand over her mouth
